_doc: How people weigh an errand before they commit to it, and again while it lasts (weigh.gd, docs/weigh.md). Cost: the time out there (the walk there, `work` seconds at it, the walk back to the nearest fire; straight-line distances count `detour` times). Risk: the health that time costs in a cold that can kill (by day, and by night once the trip runs into the dark; an announced weather from when it comes), counted `safety` times over; nothing is weighed while the cold can't kill within `horizon` seconds. An errand fits when it leaves at least `floor` of the person's health. `traits` scale the floor (cautious people keep more in hand); `need`: while a store holds less than `per_head` a head, people keep `mult` less in hand for it (hunger drives them further). While out in a deadly cold, someone heads back to the nearest fire as soon as what they have above `back_floor` only just covers the way there (counted `safety` times), checked every `check_every` seconds. Gathering weighs its node again every `recheck` seconds. `beasts`: places within `reach` of a hunting beast or a known den count `penalty` more in the choice of where to work (as if that much further).
